_comment: Fixture -> the ONE validation rule it breaks (docs/language-pack-schema.md SS7). Every pack here is otherwise a valid Structural-profile pack, so a validator test may assert the exact rule, not merely that validation failed. Both the Python pipeline validator (Phase 6) and the Swift JSONPackStore (Phase 7) read this table. Positive control: fixtures/fr-mini.pack.json must still PASS Structural.

not_covered.VR-13: aliases uniqueness - every v1 pack ships empty aliases; add a fixture when one does not.
not_covered.VR-16: language_code vs. manifest - needs the pack manifest, which lands in Phase 4/7.
not_covered.VR-17/VR-18: shippable-profile 1000-word rules - waived for fixtures by SS7.

dup-id.pack.json.why: Two entries share the id fr:je:PRON.

id-mismatch.pack.json.why: id says NOUN, pos says VERB - id is not its derivation.

sentence-content-violation.pack.json.why: Target je (rank 1) sentence uses the content word chat - the SS6 hard fail.

sentence-missing-target.pack.json.why: avoir's sentence contains no form of avoir.

wordfreq-attribution.pack.json.why: wordfreq-derived pack whose attribution omits the CC-BY-SA 4.0 credit.

future-schema-version.pack.json.why: schema_version 2 - newer than the loader supports; must fail closed as unsupportedSchemaVersion.

unresolvable-audio.pack.json.why: audio.word points at an asset that does not exist.
